import pytest
from app.page_eval import paginate
from math import ceil

@pytest.mark.parametrize('items, page, size, expected', [
    ([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 1, 2, {'items': [1, 2], 'total': 5, 'pages': 3}),
    ([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 2, 2, {'items': [3, 4], 'total': 5, 'pages': 3}),
    ([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 3, 2, {'items': [5], 'total': 5, 'pages': 3}),
    ([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 4, 2, {'items': [], 'total': 5, 'pages': 3}),
    ([], 1, 10, {'items': [], 'total': 0, 'pages': 0}),
    ([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 1, 10, {'items': [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 'total': 5, 'pages': 1})
])
def test_paginate(items, page, size, expected):
    assert paginate(items, page, size) == expected

@pytest.mark.parametrize('items, page, size, expected_exception', [
    ([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 0, 1, ValueError),
    ([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 1, 0, ValueError),
    ([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 1, 101, ValueError),
    ([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], True, 1, ValueError),
    ([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 1, False, ValueError)
])
def test_paginate_invalid_values(items, page, size, expected_exception):
    with pytest.raises(expected_exception):
        paginate(items, page, size)

def test_paginate_no_mutation():
    items = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    original_items = items.copy()
    paginate(items, 1, 2)
    assert items == original_items
